items.title: Dolphins, Jets bring plenty of futility into their first meeting of the year
items.text: The Dolphins emerge from their bye without a win and, amazingly, without holding the lead at any point in their five losses.

items.title: Jaylen Warren and the Steelers run over the Saints in Paris
items.text: Warren had another big performance as the Steelers won the NFL's first-ever game in France.

items.title: J.J. McCarthy carries four-game winning streak into first start for Giants
items.text: The 3-2-1 Giants have made a quarterback change in advance of the city known for countdowns.

items.title: Buccaneers have played in 12 straight one-score games
items.text: If the league office has a favorite team, it's currently the Buccaneers.

items.title: Jets RB Breece Hall is inactive for the third straight game
items.text: Hall was listed as questionable with a quad injury, but the Jets will have to wait at least one more week.

items.title: Steelers kick last-second field goal to take 13-10 lead over Saints at halftime in Paris
items.text: It's been a back-and-forth battle today in France.

items.title: Saints benefit from questionable replay review on T.J. Watt strip sack of Tyler Shough
items.text: What appeared to be a Saints turnover was overturned on replay, leading to a Saints field goal in Paris.

items.title: Ja'Marr Chase, who doesn't have a 100-yard game in 2026, averages 117.1 vs. Ravens
items.text: There's a very good reason for Ravens cornerback Marlon Humphrey not wanting to cover Bengals receiver Ja'Marr Chase.

items.title: Report: Peyton Manning is not expected to be a candidate for Colts G.M. job
items.text: When the Colts G.M. job became vacant six days ago, former Colts quarterback Peyton Manning was one of the first names to be mentioned.

items.title: Jaylen Warren runs Steelers to early lead over Saints in Paris
items.text: The Steelers' offense continues to revolve around Warren.

items.title: Aaron Rodgers's next touchdown pass will move him to third all time
items.text: As Aaron Rodgers prepares to become the first quarterback in NFL history to play in four different countries, he's on the verge of taking over third place on the all-time touchdown pass list.

items.title: NFL, NFLPA are "working together" to review Jalen Hurts situation
items.text: As another full Sunday of football approaches, there's a new development in the situation regarding Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts, who is likely out for the rest of the year after a "superficial" blood clot became a deep vein thrombosis and blood clots in each lung.

items.title: The Colts could trade Jonathan Taylor, and/or others, before the deadline
items.text: Seahawks, Broncos, Vikings, Packers are linked to Taylor.

items.title: Mark Sanchez's change-of-plea hearing has been rescheduled for January 25
items.text: The confusion has been resolved regarding the status of former NFL quarterback and former Fox announcer Mark Sanchez's criminal case.

items.title: Deion Sanders after Colorado's blowout loss to Oklahoma State: "I really don't understand it"
items.text: Deion Sanders's fourth season as head coach of the Colorado Buffaloes started with an upset of Georgia Tech and a blowout of overmatched Weber State.

items.title: Report: Andy Reid and Patrick Mahomes told Josh Simmons to leave a team meeting
items.text: The incident took place a day before Simmons was placed on injured reserve. Simmons later apologized.

items.title: NFLPA has yet to launch "full investigation" of Jalen Hurts situation
items.text: Hurts still have the ability to launch the ultimate external investigation: Litigation.

items.title: Travis Kelce's receiving yardage total will soon break Tony Gonzalez's tight end record
items.text: Kelce needs just 35 receiving yards to have a career total higher than Gonzalez, counting the postseason.

items.title: Bill Belichick, North Carolina fall to Syracuse in OT, 31-30
items.text: After a pair of signature wins over Pitt and Duke, North Carolina and coach Bill Belichick have fallen to ACC rival Syracuse.

items.title: Browns extend DT Maliek Collins by two years
items.text: The contract year of veteran defensive tackle Maliek Collins has resulted after only six games in new contact.

items.title: After another day of Paris protests, NFL is on track to stage Steelers-Saints at Stade de France
items.text: At this point, it's too late to turn back for Sunday's game.

items.title: Chase Young, Christen Miller were fined for violent gestures on same play
items.text: The NFL's sudden embrace of the "No Fun League" dynamic resulted in a rash of fines that were replaced with a new approach to discipline for celebrations.

items.title: Fred Warner was fined for hit on a defenseless player, Malik Mustapha was not
items.text: 49ers linebacker Fred Warner heard from the NFL a couple of times for plays he made during Week 6.

items.title: Bears' trick play fell flat due to clear rules violation
items.text: Thursday night's game between the Patriots and Bears included a trick play from Bears coach Ben Johnson.

items.title: Report: Philip Rivers is "expected to be in the mix" for NC State job
items.text: Former NFL quarterback Philip Rivers interviewed for the Bills' head-coaching job in January.

items.title: The NFL should relocate the Steelers-Saints game in Paris to London
items.text: NFL scraps multiple Saturday events due to ongoing protests.

items.title: The PFT 25th anniversary is coming next weekend
items.text: Twenty-five years ago this month, I had a decision to make.

items.text: The Eagles have left the door open for running back Saquon Barkley to play on Monday night, but they will be down two wideouts against the Cowboys.

items.title: With Troy Aikman possibly exiting broadcasting, he extends an olive branch to Jerry Jones
items.text: Hall of Fame quarterback Troy Aikman has talked openly for years about wanting to work in an NFL front office.

items.title: Texans activate WR Tank Dell to the active roster
items.text: Tank Dell will play his first game in nearly two years on Sunday when the Texans play the Giants.
